text: In World War Two, one of the soldiers was a bear.
In nineteen forty-two, Polish soldiers in Iran adopted a tiny bear cub and named him Wojtek.
He grew up with them, and copied everything they did.
To take him to Italy, they enlisted him as a private.
At Monte Cassino, he carried ammunition crates, just like his friends.
Everyone needs someone on their side.
That's why we made Feeloy. Jenny is always on your side.
